name: Trading ahead of material non-public announcements
description: A customer or linked accounts take unusually large or well-timed positions shortly before a price-sensitive event such as a takeover, results release or listing decision, then close out soon after the news.
fp: Skilled analysis of public information, sector-wide positioning, scheduled portfolio rebalancing or pre-planned option exercises can look similar. Look for repeat timing and links to insiders.

links.name: Trading ahead of material non-public announcements
links.ctx: Core insider-dealing signal, and a route for turning inside information into spendable proceeds that are then banked or moved.
